rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the national economy or the economic system, but not the academic subject itself.

example.english: Hong Kong's economy seems to be recovering this year.
example.traditional: 香港經濟今年好似開始復甦喇。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ging1 zai3 gam1 nin4 hou2 ci5 hoi1 ci2 fuk6 sou1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the lower-fare passenger section of a plane or train.

example.english: I'm flying economy to Tokyo this time.
example.traditional: 我今次搭經濟艙去東京。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 daap3 ging1 zai3 cong1 heoi3 dung1 ging1

rows.note: Use this for economics as an academic subject or field of study.

example.english: I study the economy at university.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 hok6 duk6 ging1 zai3 hok6

rows.note: Use this as a noun for frugality or the practice of using resources sparingly.

example.english: Frugality can make the household economy more stable.
example.traditional: 節儉可以令家庭經濟更穩定。
example.jyutping: zit3 gim6 ho2 ji5 ling6 gaa1 ting4 ging1 zai3 gang3 wan2 ding6
